name: GCM Commodity & Derivatives Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2005, GCM Commodity& Derivatives Ltd is engaged in the commodity
broking and investment business. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GCMCDL is in the business of trading and investments in Equity Shares. The company
 is also in the money lending business

pros: Stock is trading at 0.74 times its book value
Market value of investments Rs.3.91 Cr. is more than the Market Cap Rs.3.88 Cr.
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of -12.9% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 1,081 days.
